An '''official''' was a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EpisodeIII" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> they were present&mdash;seated next to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] of the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]]&mdash;when the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] met on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], witnessing [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] order their relocation to the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="EpisodeIII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Separatist official first appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="EpisodeIII" /> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] noted that the character was shot into the scene as a separate stage element, but that he was never able to find a name for the character, nor still photographs from that shoot.<ref name="PabloTweet">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1533986072589307906|Pablo Hidalgo|quote=Never been able to figure out who this guy at the end is. Shot as a separate stage element at ILM, no still photography exists of the shoot. Kinda looks like an Aqualish maybe? Maybe I'll pick up that mystery again someday.|archivedate=20220607013621}}</ref>
